Export a postmortem to Markdown
issues.body:
Postmortems are written in IncidentDesk, but the teams share them in the wiki, which takes Markdown. Today someone copies every section by hand.

Add `GET /postmortems/{key}/export.md`. It returns the postmortem as a Markdown document: the title, the incident it belongs to, then the sections Summary, Impact, Root cause and Actions (a checklist). A draft without a root cause is not exported.

The published postmortems are a good reference for what a finished one looks like.

Migrate from pytz to zoneinfo
issues.body:
pytz is in maintenance mode, and Python has had `zoneinfo` in the standard library since 3.9. IncidentDesk imports pytz in 40 files (code and tests).

Move every one of them to `zoneinfo` and drop pytz from the dependencies. The behaviour must stay exactly the same, daylight saving time included: `localize()` and `normalize()` have no direct equivalent and need care.

This is too big for one session. Work in steps and keep the tests green after each one.

Epic: a new API for the DemoSoft mobile app
issues.body:
The mobile app shows on-call engineers their incidents and lets them subscribe to alerts. It needs its own API under `/mobile/v1`, small and stable, separate from the internal API.

Sub-issues:
- #41 Incident list endpoint
- #42 Incident detail and timeline endpoint
- #43 Alert subscription endpoint

The contract is the response examples in each sub-issue. Lucas Ferreira (Product Owner) wants the epic done by the end of the sprint.

issues.title: Mobile API: incident list endpoint
issues.body:
`GET /mobile/v1/incidents` returns open incidents, newest first, 20 per page.

```json
{"items": [{"key": "INC-4821", "title": "Login fails for some customers", "service": "login-service", "priority": "P1", "status": "acknowledged", "opened_at": "2026-10-13T19:00:00Z"}], "next_page": 2}
```

`next_page` is null on the last page.

issues.title: Mobile API: incident detail and timeline endpoint
issues.body:
`GET /mobile/v1/incidents/{key}` returns one incident with its timeline, oldest event first.

```json
{"key": "INC-4821", "title": "Login fails for some customers", "service": "login-service", "priority": "P1", "status": "acknowledged", "opened_at": "2026-10-13T19:00:00Z", "timeline": [{"at": "2026-10-13T19:00:00Z", "kind": "opened", "note": ""}]}
```

An unknown key returns 404 with `{"error": "not_found"}`.

issues.title: Mobile API: alert subscription endpoint
issues.body: `POST /mobile/v1/subscriptions` with `{"engineer": "a.reyes", "services": ["login-service"], "min_priority": "P2"}` stores a subscription and returns it with an `id` (201). `GET /mobile/v1/subscriptions?engineer=a.reyes` lists them. An unknown service returns 422.
